footerDesc: Unofficial mortar and artillery calculator for WARDOGS. Free, online, 9 languages.
faq1q: How to calculate mortar in WARDOGS?
faq1a: Open the WARDOGS calculator, enter the coordinates of the firing position (point A) and the target (point B) on the interactive map or through input fields. The calculator will automatically calculate the distance, azimuth, and elevation in mils. Just right-click on the map — place the mortar, right-click again — place the target.
faq2q: What is the maximum mortar range in WARDOGS?
faq2a: The maximum range of the mortar in WARDOGS is 684 meters. For targets beyond 684 m, use artillery, which fires at a distance of up to 2679 m. In the calculator settings you can switch between mortar and artillery.
faq3q: Which maps are supported in the calculator?
faq3a: The calculator supports two maps: Bakurani and Ozeti. Both maps are 16×16 km with interactive tile zoom and panning. On the Bakurani map, towers and important objects are additionally displayed.
faq4q: How to calculate azimuth and elevation angle of the mortar?
faq4a: Azimuth is the direction from the firing position to the target, measured from north clockwise. Elevation (mils) is the angle of the mortar barrel to hit the target. The WARDOGS calculator calculates both values automatically based on the coordinates of points A and B.
faq5q: How many mils in a degree in WARDOGS?
faq5a: In the measurement system used in WARDOGS and military practice, one full circle equals 6400 mils. 1 degree ≈ 17.78 mils. The calculator automatically converts values and shows the elevation angle in mils, as in the game.
faq6q: WARDOGS mortar calculator — how to use online?
faq6a: The WARDOGS calculator is completely free and works online in the browser — no installation required. Set point A (mortar position) and point B (target) on the interactive map by right-clicking or enter coordinates manually. Coordinates are displayed under the cursor (from 0 to 160). Results — distance, azimuth, and elevation — are displayed instantly in the left panel.
faq7q: Can I save coordinates and share with friends?
faq7a: Yes! The calculator automatically saves all points and settings in the browser's localStorage. You can also click the "Share" button to get a link with coordinates that can be easily sent to allies on Discord or other chats.
seoAboutP1: WARDOGS Mortar Calculator — unofficial free online tool for calculating mortar and artillery fire in the tactical shooter WARDOGS. Instantly determines distance, direction (azimuth), and barrel angle (in mils) for accurate target engagement.
seoAboutP2: The calculator works on an interactive map of 16×16 km with support for two maps: Bakurani and Ozeti. Drawing tools allow marking positions, building lines and markers right on the map. All data is automatically saved and available via share links.
seoAboutP3: The interface is available in 9 languages: Russian, English, German, French, Spanish, Polish, Ukrainian, Turkish, and Chinese. The calculator is adapted for mobile devices and works in any modern browser without installation.
